ev.q: Thousands of years in the future, the Systems Commonwealth is a constitutional monarchy
spanning the Milky Way, Triangulum, and Andromeda galaxies
The Commonwealth is at war with the Magog
Hunt recruits the crew to join him in restoring the Systems Commonwealth
could offer a few campy laughs on a weekend afternoon
the scripts by Wolfe and his writing team are brimming with witty interplay
a hilariously bad slow motion fight sequence
The series premiered on October 2, 2000, and ended on May 13, 2005
